conditions.description: eVisa available for holders of a valid Schengen visa
Visa not required if holding a valid visa or residence permit from United States, United Kingdom, or Schengen countries
Visa not required for holders of Schengen residence card
eVisa with a visa waiver fee of 100 USD applies for a maximum stay of 30 days
Visa on arrival for up to 90 days for holders of valid residence permits from any country in the GCC (Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE)
Must have an international vaccination certificate
Visa not required if holding a permanent residency card from the United States

Visa required for general entry. Port visa (visa on arrival) available for special economic zones (Shenzhen, Zhuhai, Xiamen) for tourism, business, trade, transit, visits, and other non-employment purposes. Duration varies: 5 days for Shenzhen (arriving at Luohu Port, Huanggang Port Control Point, Fuyong Ferry Terminal, Shekou Passenger Terminal), 3 days for Zhuhai (Gongbei Port, Hengqin Port, Jiuzhou Port), 3 days for Xiamen (Xiamen Gaoqi International Airport). Port visa also available for urgent travel needs such as business, visits, investment, private affairs, and urgent humanitarian reasons, with supporting documents required.
No visa required for Diplomatic and Official Passport holders.
e-Visa holders must arrive via Port Bouet Airport

Visa required, obtainable at any port of entry, only for those who have valid used visas from Japan, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the United States, the United Kingdom, or European countries of the Schengen area on their passports
e-Visa must be obtained prior to arrival and holders must arrive via Addis Ababa Bole International Airport. No visa required for Diplomatic and Official Passport holders.
e-Visa available for holders of a valid Schengen visa, valid visa from OECD member countries, or valid residence permit of a Schengen Area, OECD country, or UAE
Visa on arrival for up to 15 days for valid residence permit holders of any country in the GCC (Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE)

Application must be submitted online up to 90 days prior to travel and at least 3 days in advance. Proof of hotel reservation or invitation letter required. Yellow fever vaccination certificate required if coming from endemic countries.
May not exceed 90 days within any given 12 month period

Visa not required for Bangladeshi nationals who hold a visa, re-entry permit, or permanent residency from the United States, Canada, Japan, Australia, or New Zealand when entering South Korea for transit purposes, for a stay of up to 30 days. No visa required for diplomatic and official passport holders.

e-Visa holders must arrive via Manas International Airport, Osh Airport, or land crossings with China (Irkeshtam, Torugart), Kazakhstan (Ak-jol, Ak-Tilek, Chaldybar, Chon-Kapka), Tajikistan (Bor-Dobo, Kulundu, Kyzyl-Bel), or Uzbekistan (Dostuk)
Visa required for entry. Additionally, approval must be obtained from the Immigration department of the General Directorate of General Security (La Surete Generale).
No visa required for Diplomatic and Official Passport holders up to 30 days. Single entry allowed.
Visa not required if holding a permanent residency card from Canada, Chile, Colombia, Japan, United Kingdom, Peru, United States, or any of the Schengen countries
Visa not required if holding a valid visa from Canada, Japan, United Kingdom, United States, or any of the Schengen countries

Visa required for Bangladeshi citizens. Citizens holding a residence permit or a valid visa issued by one of the European Union member states or Schengen Agreement parties can apply for an electronic visa.

Pass through and stay in Montenegro up to 30 days if holding a valid travel document containing a valid residence permit or multiple entry visa in the countries of the Schengen zone, USA, Australia, Japan, Canada, New Zealand, Ireland, or the United Kingdom, not exceeding the visa's expiry date if less than 30 days. Holder of a valid UAE 10-year residence permit may enter without visa for seven days.
e-Visa available for holders of valid visas from Schengen countries, USA, UK, or Permanent Resident Cards
Visa issued upon arrival after payment of the fee at the point of entry

e-Visa available for tourism only. Must arrive via Yangon, Nay Pyi Taw, Mandalay airports or land border crossings with Thailand (Tachileik, Myawaddy, Kawthaung) or India (Rih Khaw Dar, Tamu). No visa required for Diplomatic and Official Passport holders up to 90 days.

Online Visitor visa required. Holders of an Australian Permanent Resident Visa or Resident Return Visa may be granted a New Zealand Resident Visa on arrival permitting indefinite stay, subject to meeting character requirements and obtaining an Electronic Travel Authority prior to departure.
Visa on arrival if holding a valid visa issued by United States, Canada, or Schengen Member State

Approval from the Ministry of Interior required. Foreign citizens holding valid travel documents of third countries who hold a valid multiple-entry British, American or Canadian visa inserted in the passport, with a stay up to 15 days, and the visa validity should be 5 days longer than the planned stay
Bangladeshi holding a GCC visa of certain categories (managers, sales executives, etc.) are granted a visit visa on arrival if they are coming directly from a GCC country
Visitors may apply for an eVisa online under the "Tourist - Own Itinerary" category

Visa required for general travelers. No visa required for Diplomatic and Official Passport holders for a stay of up to 30 days. Residents of the United Arab Emirates may obtain an eVisa through the official Philippine eVisa website. A valid Emirati residence visa must be shown upon an eVisa application.
Visitors may apply for an eVisa via the Hayya website
No visa required for Official and Diplomatic passport holders
Visa not required if holding a valid Schengen Visa
Visa on Arrival or eVisa available for holders of a valid and previously used tourist visa from Schengen countries, USA, UK, or Schengen countries, or GCC residence visa holders
Visa required for holders of visas or residents from European Union member states and the United States, allowing a maximum stay of 90 days

Application can be submitted up to 30 days before travel. Visitors must upload reservation confirmation(s) for each stay in Seychelles. Yellow fever vaccination certificate required if coming from endemic countries. Payment of EUR 10 by credit or debit card. Valid for one journey only and expires once exit the country.
No visa required for diplomatic and official Passport holders. May obtain visa online.
eVisa available at Bosaso Airport, Galcaio Airport, and Mogadishu Airport
Obtainable online. Printed visa authorization must be presented at the time of travel.

eVisa or Visa on arrival for up to 60 days. Visa fees: USD 35 for SAARC countries, USD 75 for non-SAARC countries. eVisa categories will be charged an additional USD 18.50 service fee. If transiting from any Sri Lankan airports, eVisa is exempted with a 2-day transit period.

Entry and transit are refused for ordinary passport holders unless arriving for commercial delegations or as students studying at a Sudanese institute of higher education or university and holding a residence permit
Visa on arrival for up to 15 days for holders of valid residence permit from any GCC country (Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE)

No visa required for Diplomatic and Official passport holders. e-Visa available for holders of a valid Schengen visa, or a valid visa from any OECD member country (USA, Canada, etc.), or a valid residence permit of a Schengen Area or OECD country

e-Visa valid for 90 days and multiple entries. Traveling directly to Phu Quoc Island is allowed to stay on the island for up to 30 days without a visa. No visa required for Diplomatic and Official Passport holders up to 90 days.
